localSchemaFindings.finding: G1 schema uses RAG, DataRegistro, Bloqueio. The handoff text says StatusRAG, DataCheckin, Bloqueios. Flow wiring must map card values to the actual internal names.
Input/action ids are lower/mixed case: projectId, statusRAG, percentual, resumo, risco, bloqueio, proximaAcao. Flow Parse JSON must parse these ids or normalize them.
Projetos list uses ProjectID text as the business key and item ID as the SharePoint item id. Update item requires a prior Get items by ProjectID unless the card sends the SharePoint item ID.
